title: Design System: Bank Sampah Digital Desa

display.purpose: Hero headings on landing page and dashboard welcome banners.

title.purpose: Section headings (h2, h3) and card titles.

body.purpose: Default body copy, form labels, table content. 16px base for low-res screens.

label.purpose: Table column headers, stat card labels, badge text. All-caps transforms.

shadows.name: surface-sm
shadows.purpose: Base component shadow. Used on .card default state.

shadows.name: card
shadows.purpose: Primary card elevation for stat cards, content cards, and quick-links.

shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: Login card and overlay-style containers that sit above the page.

motion.name: transition-default
motion.purpose: Default button and nav transition. 0.3s for all properties.

motion.name: transition-fast
motion.purpose: Faster transition for sidebar nav hover and quick-link hover.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Default primary action button used across all views.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-block; padding: 0.5rem 1.5rem; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 500; background-color: #2e7d32; color: #ffffff; border: none; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.3s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background-color: #1b5e20; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary/outline button variant with border and transparent fill.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-block; padding: 0.5rem 1.5rem; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 500; background-color: transparent; color: #2e7d32; border: 2px solid #2e7d32; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.3s; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background-color: #2e7d32; color: #ffffff; }

components.name: Full-width Login Button
components.description: Login submit button, full-width, larger padding.
components.css: .ds-btn-login { width: 100%; padding: 1rem; background: #2e7d32; color: white; border: none; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.3s; } .ds-btn-login:hover { background: #1b5e20; }

components.name: Sidebar Navigation Link
components.description: Dashboard sidebar navigation link with emoji icon, active state border.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.8); text-decoration: none; padding: 0.875rem 1.5rem; border-left: 3px solid transparent; transition: all 0.2s; } .ds-nav-link:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1); color: #ffffff; } .ds-nav-link.ds-nav-active { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.15); color: #ffffff; border-left-color: #a5d6a7; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard form text input with green focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; padding: 0.875rem 1rem; font-size: 1rem; border: 2px solid #e0e0e0; border-radius: 8px; transition: all 0.3s; font-family: inherit; background: #ffffff; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #2e7d32; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(46, 125, 50, 0.1); } .ds-input.ds-input-invalid { border-color: #dc3545; }

components.name: Form Label
components.description: Form field label with medium weight.

components.name: Card
components.description: Primary content card with rounded corners and light shadow.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #ffffff; border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.08); overflow: hidden; margin-bottom: 1.5rem; } .ds-card-header { padding: 1.25rem 1.5rem; border-bottom: 1px solid #eeeeee; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; font-size: 1rem; color: #333333; font-weight: 600; } .ds-card-body { padding: 1.5rem; }

components.name: Stat Card
components.description: Dashboard stat card with icon + value + label layout.
components.css: .ds-stat-card { background: #ffffff; border-radius: 12px; padding: 1.5rem; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.08); display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 1rem; } .ds-stat-icon { width: 60px; height: 60px; border-radius: 12px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 1.75rem; background: #e8f5e9; color: #2e7d32; } .ds-stat-info h3 { margin: 0; font-size: 1.75rem; font-weight: 700; color: #333333; } .ds-stat-info p { margin: 0.25rem 0 0 0; color: #888888; font-size: 0.9rem; }

components.name: Success Badge
components.css: .ds-badge { padding: 0.3rem 0.6rem; border-radius: 20px; font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 600; display: inline-block; } .ds-badge-success { background: #e8f5e9; color: #2e7d32; } .ds-badge-warning { background: #fff3e0; color: #f57c00; } .ds-badge-danger { background: #ffebee; color: #c62828; } .ds-badge-info { background: #e3f2fd; color: #1976d2; } .ds-badge-secondary { background: #eceff1; color: #546e7a; }

components.name: Success Alert
components.description: Flash message alert with tinted background and icon.
components.css: .ds-alert { padding: 1rem 1.25rem; border-radius: 8px; margin-bottom: 1.5rem; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem; font-size: 0.9rem; } .ds-alert-success { background: #d4edda; color: #155724; border: 1px solid #c3e6cb; } .ds-alert-error { background: #f8d7da; color: #721c24; border: 1px solid #f5c6cb; } .ds-alert-warning { background: #fff3cd; color: #856404; border: 1px solid #ffeeba; } .ds-alert-info { background: #d1ecf1; color: #0c5460; border: 1px solid #bee5eb; }

components.name: Quick Link
components.description: Dashboard quick action card with icon + text, hover border highlight.
components.css: .ds-quick-link { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem; padding: 1rem; background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #e0e0e0; border-radius: 8px; text-decoration: none; color: #333333; transition: all 0.2s; } .ds-quick-link:hover { border-color: #2e7d32; background: #f1f8e9; } .ds-quick-link-icon { width: 40px; height: 40px; background: #e8f5e9; border-radius: 8px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 1.25rem; } .ds-quick-link h4 { margin: 0; font-size: 0.9rem; } .ds-quick-link p { margin: 0; font-size: 0.8rem; color: #888888; }

narrative.overview:
A nature-inspired, grounded, and approachable design language for village-level government software. The aesthetic draws from Indonesian village life — forest canopies, terraced rice fields, and community gathering — expressed through deep greens, clean surfaces, and generous, friendly forms. Every element feels rooted in place, not generic corporate software.

The system prioritizes legibility for low-digital-literacy users: high contrast text, large touch targets, and clear visual hierarchy. The interface recedes so the task leads. At its best, it feels like a trusted neighbor — warm, reliable, and always ready to help.
keyCharacteristics: Deep forest-green primary palette with secondary blue for data and status
Soft, approachable forms: 12px corners on cards, generous padding throughout
Light structural shadows that lift content without drama
Inline emoji icons as universal visual anchors for Bahasa Indonesia speakers
Responsive mobile-first layout for low-end smartphones
Consistent dashboard shell with sidebar navigation for authenticated roles

rules.name: The Natural Contrast Rule
rules.body: Primary green (#2e7d32) on white meets WCAG AA at all text sizes. Status colors on their matching tinted backgrounds are legible and visually calm.

rules.name: The Line Length Rule
rules.body: Body text does not exceed 75ch. All text containers respect this through the .container { max-width: 1200px } constraint.

rules.name: The Breathing Room Rule
rules.body: Section gaps use 2rem between major layout sections. Internal component padding uses 1.5rem. Never stack content with less than 1rem gap.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Rest Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadows appear only on containers (cards, sidebar) that need to visually separate from the page. Buttons, inputs, and badges are flat — no shadow on interactive elements.

rules.name: The Border-Color Rule
rules.body: Form inputs use #e0e0e0 borders at rest and shift to primary green on focus. Error states use #dc3545. Focus states include a subtle green glow.

dos: Do use the primary green (#2e7d32) consistently for primary CTAs, the main header, and the sidebar gradient.
Do use emoji icons as visual anchors in navigation and card titles (e.g., '📊 Dashboard', '👥 Kelola').
Do use the pill-shaped badge pattern for all status labels.
Do maintain the sidebar + main content layout for all authenticated role views.
Do use border-radius: 12px on stat cards and welcome banners for a welcoming feel.
Do wrap tables in .table-responsive { overflow-x: auto } for mobile compatibility.
Do use the gradient (135deg, #2e7d32 to #1b5e20) for sidebar and login background.
donts: Don't use primary green as text on backgrounds other than white or the lightest tint.
Don't add drop shadows to buttons or input fields — keep interactive elements flat.
Don't use decorative fonts, italics for body text, or condensed typefaces.
Don't create single-page dashboard layouts without the sidebar shell.
Don't mix Bahasa Indonesia with English labels in UI copy — keep it consistent.
Don't use status colors bare (e.g., red text on white) for alerts — always use tinted backgrounds.
